### Overview

### Keys & Options Defined

]
```

- `↑` / `Up` - Up arrow
- `↓` / `Down` - Down arrow
- `←` / `Left` - Left arrow
- `→` / `Right` - Right arrow

- **Hints row** at bottom showing volume button controls (lines 389-396)

- Section tabs at top (lines 319-345) allow filtering by Input/Terminal/Workspace/AI

  - Vol- = cycle through actions in current section (line 783)
  - Vol+ = select/confirm action (line 807)
  - Swipe = change section (line 309)
  - 2x Vol- = close popup (line 794)

| Feature | TerminalInputBar | Quick Actions Popup |
|---------|------------------|---------------------|
| **Trigger** | Tap text field or always-visible when focused | Long-press card or Vol++ |
| **UI Type** | Docked toolbar below terminal | Modal overlay |
| **Input display** | Horizontal scrollable chips + text field | Grid tiles with section tabs |
| **Key types** | Special keys + command suggestions | Special keys + custom commands + terminal ops |
| **Keyboard availability** | When terminal is focused & not browser | Anytime a terminal is focused |
| **Backend method** | `surface.send_key` or `surface.send_text` | `surface.send_key` or `surface.send_text` |

Both ultimately route through `AppState.sendKey()` (line 226-228) → `surface.send_key` RPC to the bridge backend.
